articles.title: Help EFF Solve an Issue That's Bigger than Creepy Ads
articles.summary: Microsoft patches 167 vulns including a SharePoint zero-day and Windows Defender's 'BlueHammer' flaw, while Chrome fixes its fourth zero-day this year. AI finding bugs faster than humans can patch them — welcome to the future, meatbags.

articles.title: A “Scheme” Against Dobbs: SCOTUS Dissent Hints at Next Phase of Abortion Rights Fight
articles.summary: Second CVSS 10.0 Cisco SD-WAN bug exploited in the wild this year. When your network control system has maximum severity vulns getting popped, maybe it's time to rethink that 'software-defined' strategy.

articles.title: Anti-DDoS Firm Heaped Attacks on Brazilian ISPs
articles.summary: Canvas education platform breached, disrupting schools nationwide after hackers defaced login pages with ransom demands. Nothing says 'back to school' like having your homework held hostage by cybercriminals.

articles.title: MPs want social media treated more like unsafe toys than harmless apps
articles.summary: OpenAI employees got pwned via TanStack npm supply chain attack, with malware-laced packages hitting staff machines. Even the AI overlords can't escape the classic 'employee clicked the bad thing' scenario.

articles.title: Canvas Hack Aftermath: Congress Wants Instructure to Answer Questions
articles.summary: TeamPCP hackers are auctioning off Mistral AI's source code after breaching their repos. French AI startup learns the hard way that 'Mistral' doesn't just describe Mediterranean winds, but also how fast your code can leak.

articles.title: Victory! End-to-End Encrypted RCS Comes to Apple and Android Chats
articles.summary: Instagram killed its opt-in end-to-end encryption feature, abandoning years of promises to encrypt DMs by default. Meta once again proves that privacy commitments have the lifespan of a mayfly in a hurricane.

articles.title: EFF Launches New Offline Campaign for Saudi Wikipedian Osama Khalid
articles.summary: Victory! Apple finally enables end-to-end encryption for RCS chats with Android devices in iOS 26.5. Only took them a decade to stop making cross-platform messaging deliberately suck for privacy.

articles.title: The Boring Stuff is Dangerous Now
articles.summary: EFF launches campaign for Saudi Wikipedian Osama Khalid, imprisoned for contributing to open knowledge since age 12. Apparently editing Wikipedia in Arabic is now a thought crime worth international attention.

articles.title: How Trump’s New Counterterrorism Strategy Puts You at Risk
articles.summary: Trump's new counterterrorism strategy literally threatens to hunt down political enemies with 'We will find you and we will kill you' rhetoric. The war on terror comes home with a vengeance and a Twitter account.

articles.title: For ‘Survivor’ Legends Who Keep Coming Back, Outplaying and Outlasting Is a ‘Religious Experience’
articles.summary: Pwn2Own Berlin day two: researchers earned $385K for 15 zero-days, bringing the total to $908K over two days. Microsoft Exchange fell along with everything else — proving that ethical hacking pays better than most day jobs.
